Fixed both stream watermark and late event handling issues:

1. In src/stream/watermark.py: Updated the update() method to use max(self.current_watermark, candidate) ensuring the watermark is monotonic (never decreases).

2. In src/stream/window.py: Modified add_event() to check if event is late (self.tracker.is_late(event_time)) BEFORE updating tracker and storing the event. Returns False for late events.

All 2 tests now pass in tests/test_stream_visible.py.

Fixed stream watermark and late event handling:
1. Updated watermark.py to make current_watermark monotonic using max()
2. Updated window.py to reject late events before adding them to windows
All tests now pass.

Fixed both defects:
1. In src/ledger/fx.py, changed FX calculation to subtract fee before applying rate: (tx.amount - tx.fee) * fx_rate
2. In src/ledger/reconciler.py, updated deduplication to use (source, id) tuple instead of just tx.id

Tests now pass.

Fixed two bugs in the rate limiter:

1. In `src/ratelimit/bucket.py`: The prune method was keeping timestamps `t < cutoff` (expired) instead of `t >= cutoff` (valid). Changed condition to `t >= cutoff` to retain only timestamps within the window.

2. In `src/ratelimit/limiter.py`: The allow method used `> max_requests` instead of `>= max_requests`, allowing one extra request. Changed to `>=` to correctly block when the limit is reached.

All tests now pass.

Fixed two bugs in the rate limiter:
